exposure: type of Medicaid (traditional Medicaid and pregnancy Medicaid)
outcome: receipt of outpatient care during the perinatal period
average number of outpatient visits during preconception, prenatal, and postpartum periods
cohort: The cohort consisted of pregnant beneficiaries in Oregon and South Carolina with Medicaid-covered births between 2014 and 2019.
finding: Traditional Medicaid recipients had a higher average number of preconception, prenatal, and postpartum outpatient visits compared to those with pregnancy Medicaid.
